This is your go-to channel for back pain solutions, recovery tools, and honest product reviews — all from a doctor’s perspective.
Hosted by Dr. Michael Pound, a chiropractor and integrative pain practitioner, we test and review gear that helps you heal faster — without drugs or surgery.

Here, you'll find expert tips, actionable advice, and natural solutions to help you live pain-free and feel your best.

💡 Subscribe Now and start your journey toward better sleep, less pain, and a healthier, happier you!

DISCLAIMER:
The content on this channel is for general educational and informational purposes only. It is NOT medical advice and should not be used to diagnose, treat, or cure any health or medical condition. Always consult with a licensed healthcare provider for personalized care. By using this content, you agree to indemnify Dr. Pound and affiliates from any claims, losses, or damages. Use at your own risk.
